gear.name: Patched Wetsuit
gear.description: Sefton swears the patches are the strongest part. Adds two grit.

gear.name: Brass Compass
gear.description: It points home, mostly. Hear more detail about each heading before you choose.

gear.name: Salvage Net
gear.description: Knotted by someone who hated losing things. Drifting caches yield more.

gear.name: Lucky Bobber
gear.description: Bright red, chewed by something. Fish find it irresistible.

gear.name: Braided Tow Rope
gear.description: Rated for more than your boat weighs. Rescues hold together longer.

gear.name: Flare Kit
gear.description: One bright way out. Once per tide, escape a squall before it bites.

gear.name: Riveted Hull Plates
gear.description: Ugly, heavy, wonderful. Adds three to maximum hull.

gear.name: Storm Anchor
gear.description: A sea anchor cut for squall work. Storm crossings punish you less.
